bridge.where: Ur in Mesopotamia, then Canaan, Egypt and the valley of Makkah
text: Ibrahim, known as Abraham in the Bible, is honoured by Muslims, Jews and Christians alike. He is born among idol-makers. His own father, Azar, carves idols.
This long chapter follows his whole life: his search for the truth, the fire, his journeys, his sons Ismail and Ishaq, the test of the sacrifice, and the House he raised in Makkah, the Ka'ba.
